facts.fact: The Resin House kennels have hounds that stir at the cages and know every boot in the yard; they would scent an outsider on the flagged path to the well house.
Pachan held a net in the yard the day Chathu bound Neela three weeks ago and looked at his boots; he gave her the sweet at ten (consistent with F232/F493).
Devan proposes going in himself for the book and Neela rejects it: eight hunters, hounds and his unknown scent and boots on the flagged path.
